notes.title: v1.1 Ouncer Update
notes.content:
Welcome to Note Brawl v1.1! In this update, you'll be able to play as a new brawler and you'll be able to play some minigames!

[h1]Ouncer[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42049160/6274c313617038a8117988540add096db9334953.png[/img]

Ouncer is a character that focuses on flexibility. By switching channels he can gain a variety of effects that could help him at any point during a match. Available instantly with the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1925680/Note_Brawl__Brawl_Pass/]brawl pass[/url] or for 800 ink in the gallery!

[h1]Mini Games[/h1]
There are two available minigames accessible from the brawl screen.
[list]
[*] Target Shot: Use the ball to shoot as many targets as possible. When you hit more, your time increases so you can try to get a higher score!
[*] Trace Race: Follow the circle in the arena. As you fail to catch up to it, your time will steadily decrease until it's game over.
[/list]

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
As I'm still working on stabilizing the server, I'm not very confident in any characters needing massive nerfs. In this patch, I focused on improving the first three characters so that they can keep up with the rest of the roster.

Added:
[list]
[*]Ouncer- a stance swapping flexible brawler
[/list]
Buffed:
[list]
[*]Wheelar
[list]
[*]Increased movement speed: 5 -> 5.5
[*]Increased charge rate: 6 -> 6.5
[/list]
[*]Yummony
[list]
[*]Increased size by 20%
[*]Reworked "Eat". The range of this ability has increased, and it now has a small delay after activation. stamina cost of "Spit" decreased.
[*]Dashing no longer starts "Spit"
[/list]
[*]Skulte
[list]
[*]Increased the ability to lock a skull in place after it is summoned.
[*]Increased the lifetime of each skull by 0.5s
[/list]
[/list]

Nerfed:
[list]
[*]Ampyre
[list]
[*]Decreased drain amount. 10->7
[/list]
[/list]
Known issues:
[list]
[*]Light ball effect activates constantly
[/list]

You can expect some balance changes in the coming days, but it will be a while before the next major update. Hop into the [url=https://discord.gg/qgGWqKAkxR]discord [/url] if you'd like to interact with the community, and see more regular updates!

notes.title: V1.0.3 Hotfix and Sneak Peek
notes.content:
Quick hotfix addressing the following reported issues:

Thanks for playing! Hop into the [url=https://discord.gg/qgGWqKAkxR]discord [/url]if you'd like to report any issues.
